The existing code uses `z.get("top", 0)` with a default, but `zCat` uses `z.get("zCat")` with no default, so if zCat is missing the zone is silently dropped from that array but still present in others, creating an array-length mismatch that Pine will report as a shape error.
comments.existing_code:
add("e1_injected_top", "float", [z.get("top", 0) for z in zones])
    add("e1_injected_bottom", "float", [z.get("bottom", 0) for z in zones])
    add("e1_injected_confluence", "int", [int(z.get("confluence", 0)) for z in zones])
    add("e1_injected_zfp", "int", [int(z.get("zfp", 0)) for z in zones])
    # zCat — the v8 renderer's positional vocabulary (RES|MID|SUP). VALIDATED, never defaulted:
    # a missing zCat silently became "SUP" (a teal wrong-colour) — refuse instead (audit 2026-10-05).
    for z in zones:
        if z.get("zCat") not in ("RES", "MID", "SUP"):
            sys.exit(f"HARD STOP — zone {z.get('name','?')} has zCat={z.get('zCat')!r}; "
                     f"the renderer requires RES|MID|SUP")
    add("e1_injected_cat", "string", [f'"{_q(z.get("zCat"))}"' for z in zones])
    add("e1_injected_id", "string", [f'"{_q(z.get("name", "Z"))}"' for z in zones])

comments.content: The `strip_decl()` regex `rf"^{n}\s*=\s*array\.from\("`, called with `E1_NAMES` and `E2_NAMES`, only removes `array.from(...)` declarations. It does not strip the `e1_injected_anchor_ms` and `e1_injected_week_tag` scalar declarations added by `build_payload()` (lines 145-146). If `e1-render.pine` already contains these declarations (e.g., from a prior unstripped injection run), the output will contain duplicate variable declarations and fail the Pine transpiler. Consider adding these names to `E1_NAMES` or using a more general pattern.
